reason: Both correctly identify the LEFT JOIN/WHERE bug, the UTC-vs-UTC+8 boundary issue, integer division, and NULL-vs-zero totals with similarly accurate explanations, but Response A also catches a real additional defect—non-aggregated columns (c.name, c.signup_date) selected under a GROUP BY on customer_id only, which can error on strict engines like SQL Server—and appropriately caveats the engine-dependent nature of the risk. Response B is well-written but misses this issue entirely, so A is more complete without introducing incorrect claims.
